answer: Every claim climbs the yarrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pulse re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, diluted when peers disagree, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The wander of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
